messages:
Liam H: heads up 1 Nebula asked for a marketplace SKU in eu-southwest-2 and a soft quota of 40 GPUs for launch. they want a joint announcement in ~6 weeks.
Maya P: ok1 legal + finance need to review the terms before we list. ill pull the exhibit template.
Jess K: ops clarifying question 1 reserved capacity or partner-backed marketplace entitlement?
Liam H: partner-backed marketplace entitlement. Nebula will underwrite the first month so customers see available quota.
Ana R: networking/KMS note: they plan customer VPC peering and will use their KMS tenant. we need cross-account key policy + peering CIDR validation.
Yi C: sales note: a few Madrid customers asked for Madrid-region latency. Nebula has a local CSP partner so latency should be good.
Maya P: legal might ask for a short SLA exhibit for the launch window.
Jess K: ops checklist: - allocate 40 A100-equiv vGPUs in eu-southwest-2 - create marketplace SKU + entitlement mapping - draft cross-account KMS policy - validate VPC peering + egress routes - create dashboard (p50/p90 latency, token cost) - schedule perf window after peering
Liam H: Ana, can you draft the KMS policy and a peering runbook? link to templates: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/marketplace-onboard
Ana R: will do. aim to post a PR with the policy snippet by EOD.
Yi C: target beta customers: Acme EU, Fathom Health, Snapline. ill hold outreach until quotas confirmed.
Maya P: finance question: who pays the initial commit invoice? Nebula or do we bill them?
Liam H: Nebula pays the initial commit; afterwards standard CSP marketplace billing applies. ops will share unit economics.
Jess K: @deploy-bot can you open a quota request for 40 (->120 scale) and attach here?
deploy-bot: Ticket created Q-2028-3310. ETA allocation: 48h. link: https://infra.tickets/Q-2028-3310
Liam H: perf targets: p50 embeddings < 60ms, p90 gen < 200ms. Jess pls run perf after peering.
Maya P: adding contracts and finance to thread now.
Ana R: PR created: https://git.internal/repos/nebula-integration/pulls/12 (KMS + runbook).
Liam H: action items: Ana - KMS & runbook (EOD). Jess - reserve GPUs & perf window (48h). Maya - legal/finance loop (2 business days). Yi - customer invites after quota confirmed. deploy-bot - ticket Q-2028-3310.
Maya P: tentative announcement target 2024-12-15. flag blockers in this thread. :rocket:
